I grow wheat on this quarter-gabi of land that I own, and I know wheat needs fertilizer to yield well, so I will buy DAP and urea from the cooperative like most farmers around here do. I will sow the local wheat seed I kept from last harvest because improved seed is costly and hard to find in our area. My family will prepare the land with our oxen, plant, weed, and harvest this small plot ourselves since paying workers is too expensive for such a small piece. We depend only on the rains here and do not spray chemicals because rust has not been bad lately and pesticides are too expensive.
